methods.name: moderatorActivity
methods.desc: Counted actions in the current epoch (`actions`) and the epoch before it (`previousActions`)

version.desc: the current version of the contract

akitaDAO.desc: the app ID of the Akita DAO

moderators.desc: Who is a moderator, and when they last took a moderation action (0 = never)

banned.desc: Who is banned and when they can return

actions.desc: Actions usable on an akita post

activity.desc:
Counted moderation actions per moderator. addModerator creates it and removeModerator deletes it,
so the box MBR moves with the moderators box, from and back to this app's balance. Moderators
added before this box existed get it on their first counted action.
